chatango.title: Chatango Settings
chatango.room_handle_help: The name of your Chatango room
chatango.dashboard_help: Show Chatango in the dashboard shoutbox area
chatango.widget_help: Show a collapsible Chatango widget on pages
chatango.embed_help: Copy these embed codes to use Chatango on external pages or OBS browser sources. The dashboard and widget embeds are automatically managed by this plugin.
chatango.page_description: Chatango settings stay aligned with the active LTTH theme so the panel blends with the rest of the app across day, night, contrast, vision-impaired, and Cid modes.
chatango.about_text: This plugin provides Chatango chat room integration for your stream. Configure your chat room settings, theme appearance, and widget options. The chat will automatically sync with your application's theme (day/night/high contrast mode).
chatango.room_handle_example: The name of your Chatango room (e.g., "pupcidsltth")
chatango.preview_warning: ⚠️ Live preview requires the Chatango embed script to load.
chatango.preview_instructions: Save your configuration and refresh the dashboard to see changes.
chatango.save_failure_detail: Please review your settings and try again.
